_: The shape of the secrets file the run keeps outside any repository and deletes, on the person's word, once every value is in the parameter store. A value is what the run generated or derived, what the person gave, or the word later; a provider the person did not choose has no line.
DATABASE_CA: derived: the regional certificate bundle of the database service, as PEM
S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID: derived: the access key id of the files user
TUNNEL_TOKEN: derived: the connector token of the tunnel
GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET: asked: the client secret of the OAuth app, or later
GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET: asked: the client secret of the OAuth client, or later
